title: Supplier invoice intake
description: Reads supplier invoices, extracts every line into a table and flags differences against the purchase order.

spec.output: Structured invoice table with checks against open purchase orders
spec.whereItRuns: Microsoft 365: SharePoint library + Power Automate flow

problem: Accounts payable keys every supplier invoice into the system by hand, then checks it line by line against the purchase order. Price and quantity differences are easy to miss when the queue is long, and they surface later as overpayments or disputes.

steps.label: Input
steps.text: Invoice arrives by email or is dropped into a SharePoint folder.

steps.label: AI step
steps.text: Claude reads the document and extracts header fields and line items.

steps.label: Check
steps.text: Totals are recalculated and every line is compared with the open purchase order.

steps.label: Output
steps.text: Clean invoices go to posting. Flagged ones land in the AP review queue with the reasons.

stack.name: Claude
stack.role: Reads the invoice and extracts header fields and line items.

stack.name: SharePoint
stack.role: Holds incoming invoices and the review queue.

stack.name: Power Automate
stack.role: Picks up new invoices, runs the checks and routes the result.

stack.name: Excel
stack.role: Open purchase order export used for matching.

tryIt.placeholder: Paste the text of a supplier invoice, or upload a PDF or image…

samples.label: Northvale Fasteners: price and quantity differences
Quillmere Cleaning: missing PO, wrong due date
